emphasis.publisher_locator: game_rules.pdf page 2, Regeln für den Bohnenhandel
emphasis.text: A single agreed trade may contain multiple cards on either side and the bundle sizes may differ, for example two cards for one. Cards may come from arbitrary hand positions. Represent the complete proposed bundles atomically, leave both hands unchanged while awaiting consent, and transfer every referenced card only after acceptance. Do not reduce source-legal multi-card bundles to single-card-only proposals.
Apply the printed Garden Bean meter exactly: 1 Garden Bean pays 0 coins; 2 Garden Beans pay 2 coins; 3 or more Garden Beans pay 3 coins. There is no 1-coin Garden payout.
Apply the printed Soy Bean thresholds exactly: sizes 0–1 pay 0; 2–3 pay 1; 4–5 pay 2; size 6 pays 3; size 7 or more pays 4.

If the draw pile becomes empty for the third time while revealing in phase 2, finish phases 2 and 3 only. As soon as all required phase-3 planting is complete, perform the final harvest and make the state terminal. Do not enter or require a phase-4 draw.
